# DRX Cleaning Company

> DRX Cleaning Company provides professional carpet cleaning, upholstery cleaning, sofa cleaning, mattress sanitization, stain removal, odor removal, area rug cleaning, residential cleaning, and commercial carpet cleaning services in Orlando and Central Florida.

Website: https://www.drxcleaning.com/
Phone: +1 321-315-8595
Email: info@drxcleaning.com
Primary Location: Orlando, Florida, United States
Service Area: Orlando and Central Florida

## Business Summary

DRX Cleaning Company is a local cleaning service specializing in professional carpet cleaning and fabric care for homes, apartments, offices, rental properties, commercial spaces, and property managers. Services include hot-water extraction carpet cleaning, upholstery and sofa cleaning, mattress sanitization, pet stain and odor removal, area rug cleaning, deep cleaning, and commercial carpet cleaning.

The company emphasizes eco-friendly cleaning products, licensed and insured service, same-day or next-day availability when scheduling allows, and a satisfaction-focused service experience.
